promotion_decision.decision: A. APPROVE AS CURRENT DEMO DEFAULT CHAT WITH AUDITED SAFETY FALLBACKS

single_hypothesis: Stable backend-owned IMG_n labels, deterministic reference resolution, role-preserving bounded history, and strict four-field validation remove model-generated asset identity failures while supporting real multi-turn image references.

message_contract.system: rendered fixed rules plus structured summary and state
message_contract.history: last five complete user/assistant pairs as separate Chat Template roles
